title: Toy Taxes May Go Up Soon
story: Toy companies might have to pay more taxes soon. This means they could have less money to make new toys.
storyBig: Toy manufacturers are anticipating potential increases in their tax obligations, which could limit their budget for innovation and development.

bear: Higher taxes might make toys more expensive.
